Name: Animal Patting
Author: DiddyP
Description:
Your sweet and dedicated spouse will wake up early each morning to pat the animals so that you have more time to tend to other farm business.
Don't worry, they'll still get the love and thank you for it :)

Features:
[list]
[*]You can customise the speech in the config.json file for each individual person.
[*]Suppress message by changing the flag in the config.json file.
[*]set the possibility of fulfilling the daily task by changing the percentage of success in the config.json.

[/list]

Manifest.Name: Animal Patting
Manifest.Description: Your spouse will pat the animals at the start of the day.
